## Description

Bath & Shower Seat Classic is a height-adjustable bath chair designed to provide seated support in most standard tubs and showers. The molded seat includes side handles for leverage when sitting or standing and drainage openings to help reduce standing water on the surface.

The aluminum legs adjust to match different tub and user heights, and non-slip tips at each foot help stabilize the seat on wet surfaces. The lightweight frame makes the chair easier to move or remove between uses while still providing a durable option for routine bathing.
